name: v18.1.1
body:
## [18.1.1](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/compare/v18.1.0...v18.1.1) (2026-10-12)


### Bug Fixes

* **cli:** honor an explicitly empty string input ([#4113](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4113)) ([ec3a4e5](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/ec3a4e511aa0d60b3e9ab8aa0c769407cdaf08d9))
* end blockquote before a lazy line after a heading, hr or html block ([#4115](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4115)) ([9e64a6a](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/9e64a6a3fe6b826d113fc337c21ebe345455a842))
* keep a backslash in a code span from hiding emphasis ([#4117](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4117)) ([6a57018](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/6a57018fc906333d358981682fd693e4bb85940f))
* keep a decoded character reference from forming a new one ([#4111](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4111)) ([6bbac0c](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/6bbac0cdb72cc3038baefe768c03f788e46126a5)), closes [#38](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/38) [#112](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/112)
* let indented and type 3-5 html blocks interrupt a paragraph ([#4124](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4124)) ([eaa1fff](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/eaa1fffb30fa334cc11ab93f1e5aaa1d2b916e7c))
* make walkTokens linear by appending values in place ([#4121](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4121)) ([627d9ae](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/627d9ae4e5ea403580782a8f6e21fbc8bf56f4c1)), closes [#4120](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4120)
* match pre, script, style and textarea as whole tag names ([#4114](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4114)) ([0db74cb](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/0db74cb0194f3acb5a53b14a73c2cd087c3c9981))
* preserve enclosing link state after parsing images ([#4123](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4123)) ([cc07bb9](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/cc07bb9cb62bfd41a724d0a426f194188d7b35c1))
* respect tab stops in list continuation indentation ([#4119](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4119)) ([4bd2528](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/4bd252811fb24ca6b7e22f60c39b89efc2b265d2))


### Performance Improvements

* avoid repeated raw string copies in nested lists ([#4082](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4082)) ([7e8754d](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/7e8754d60b3c37be30aa17106ada623d1f0cf9db))
